kpi.title: People KPI Table
kpi.formulaBanner: KPI Score (0–100) = (Final Completion Rate × 60%) + (On-time Rate × 40%). Denominator excludes paused tasks (On-time = 100, Late = 60, Incomplete = 0; 1H Response & Late Rate are reference-only). Month/Quarter/Year use Final Completion Date. Recurring tasks are counted per cycle; paused tasks are excluded. Grades: A ≥ 90, B ≥ 80, C ≥ 60, D < 60.
